Name: (AT) Colorful Hay Bales
Author: PapesPaperchu
Description:
As it says in the title, it's textures for the ornamental hay bale! [s]Now there's finally an excuse to use it as decoration



[/s]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for letting me use the color palettes from her Cake Wheat and Pastry Wheat found in her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13889]Pixie Forage mod
[/url]﻿to make the hay bales with, because that's how the rest of them came to be. Because I really wanted to have those two as decorative hay stacks. Please go check out her mods, they're all amazing!

Also thank you to everyone who helped me in the stardew discord and were supportive!
